description: Take-home pay for an employee in Poland from a gross yearly salary in PLN, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: PIT 12%/32% with the 30,000 zł tax-free amount; Zero-PIT reliefs: under 26, return relief, families with 4+ children; Joint return with a spouse; Child relief with the refundable part; PPK, 50% author costs, higher commuting costs; ZUS up to the 2026 cap, 9% health contribution.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

author.description: Share of pay under copyright. Creative work (software, design, writing): 50% costs on that part, up to 120,000 zł of costs. (%). Default 0.

commuter.description: Live outside the town where you work. Standard costs of 300 zł instead of 250 zł a month. Default false.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many PLN, for the euro amounts. Default 4.25 (indicative).

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in PLN, without bonus

joint.description: Joint return with spouse Default true.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

ppk.description: Employee Capital Plan (PPK). You pay 2%, the employer 1.5% (taxable for you). Default false.

return_relief.description: Return relief (ulga na powrót). For 4 years after moving to Poland, for Polish citizens or people with Polish roots who lived abroad for 3+ years. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in PLN, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in Poland (2026)
